journeys.title: Conversion and early years
journeys.summary: Saul sets out to arrest believers, meets the risen Christ near Damascus, and is later brought to Antioch by Barnabas.

stops.label: Jerusalem
stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.text: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.
stops.note: Saul asks the high priest for letters to the synagogues of Damascus.

stops.label: Damascus
stops.name: Damascus
stops.text: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:
stops.note: "Suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven."

stops.label: Arabia
stops.name: Arabia
stops.text: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.
stops.note: "I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus." Where in Arabia is not said.

stops.label: Damascus
stops.name: Damascus
stops.text: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.
stops.note: He preaches Christ in the synagogues; the disciples let him down the wall in a basket (Acts 9:20–25).

stops.label: Jerusalem
stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.text: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.
stops.note: Barnabas brings him to the apostles; "after three years" (Galatians 1:18).

stops.label: Caesarea
stops.name: Caesarea
stops.text: Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.
stops.note: The brethren bring him down to Caesarea, because the Grecians sought to slay him.

stops.label: Tarsus
stops.name: Tarsus
stops.text: Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.
stops.note: Sent forth to Tarsus, the city of his birth (Acts 22:3).

stops.label: Antioch
stops.name: Antioch
stops.text: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.
stops.note: Barnabas brings him to Antioch, where the disciples were first called Christians.

journeys.title: First missionary journey
journeys.summary: Sent out from Antioch with Barnabas: Cyprus, then the cities of southern Galatia, then home to report, and on to the council at Jerusalem.

stops.label: Antioch
stops.name: Antioch
stops.text: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
stops.note: "Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them" (13:2).

stops.label: Seleucia
stops.name: Seleucia
stops.text: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.

stops.label: Salamis
stops.name: Salamis
stops.text: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.
stops.note: They preach in the synagogues of the Jews; John Mark is with them.

stops.label: Paphos
stops.name: Paphos
stops.text: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Barjesus:
stops.note: Elymas the sorcerer is struck blind; the deputy Sergius Paulus believes.

stops.label: Perga
stops.name: Perga
stops.text: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.
stops.note: John Mark departs and returns to Jerusalem.

stops.label: Antioch in Pisidia
stops.name: Antioch
stops.text: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.
stops.note: Paul's sermon in the synagogue (13:16–41).

stops.label: Iconium
stops.name: Iconium
stops.text: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.
stops.note: They shake off the dust of their feet against them.

stops.label: Lystra
stops.name: Lystra
stops.text: They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:
stops.note: A cripple healed; the people call them Jupiter and Mercurius; Paul is stoned (14:19).

stops.label: Derbe
stops.name: Derbe
stops.text: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.
stops.note: "The next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe."

stops.label: Lystra
stops.name: Lystra
stops.text: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,
stops.note: They return, "confirming the souls of the disciples" (14:22).

stops.label: Iconium
stops.name: Iconium
stops.text: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,

stops.label: Antioch
stops.name: Antioch
stops.text: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,

stops.label: Perga
stops.name: Perga
stops.text: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:
stops.note: "When they had preached the word in Perga…"

stops.label: Attalia
stops.name: Attalia
stops.text: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:

stops.label: Antioch
stops.name: Antioch
stops.text: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.
stops.note: They tell "how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles" (14:27).

stops.label: Jerusalem
stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.text: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.
stops.note: Passing through Phenice and Samaria (15:3) to the council at Jerusalem.

stops.label: Antioch
stops.name: Antioch
stops.text: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:
stops.note: The council's letter is delivered at Antioch.

journeys.title: Second missionary journey
journeys.summary: With Silas, and later Timothy and Luke: the gospel crosses into Europe — Philippi, Thessalonica, Berea, Athens and Corinth.

stops.label: Antioch
stops.name: Antioch
stops.text: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
stops.note: Paul and Barnabas part; Paul chooses Silas and goes through Syria and Cilicia (15:40–41).

stops.label: Derbe
stops.name: Derbe
stops.text: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:

stops.label: Lystra
stops.name: Lystra
stops.text: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:
stops.note: Timothy joins them.

stops.label: Mysia
stops.name: Mysia
stops.text: After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.
stops.note: Forbidden to preach in Asia, and the Spirit suffered them not to go into Bithynia.

stops.label: Troas
stops.name: Troas
stops.text: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.
stops.note: The vision of the man of Macedonia: "Come over into Macedonia, and help us" (16:9).

stops.label: Samothracia
stops.name: Samothrace
stops.text: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;
stops.note: "We came with a straight course to Samothracia."

stops.label: Neapolis
stops.name: Neapolis
stops.text: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;

stops.label: Philippi
stops.name: Philippi
stops.text: And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.
stops.note: Lydia is baptized; Paul and Silas sing praises at midnight in prison; the jailer believes.

stops.label: Amphipolis
stops.name: Amphipolis
stops.text: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:

stops.label: Apollonia
stops.name: Apollonia
stops.text: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:

stops.label: Thessalonica
stops.name: Thessalonica
stops.text: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:
stops.note: Three sabbath days in the synagogue; the city is set in an uproar.

stops.label: Berea
stops.name: Berea
stops.text: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.
stops.note: The Bereans "searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so" (17:11).

stops.label: Athens
stops.name: Athens
stops.text: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to him with all speed, they departed.
stops.note: Paul is sent "to go as it were to the sea" (17:14). On Mars' hill: "the unknown god" (17:22–31).

stops.label: Corinth
stops.name: Corinth
stops.text: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth;
stops.note: A year and six months with Aquila and Priscilla (18:11).

stops.label: Cenchrea
stops.name: Cenchreae
stops.text: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow.
stops.note: "Having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow."

stops.label: Ephesus
stops.name: Ephesus
stops.text: And he came to Ephesus, and left them there: but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.
stops.note: He reasons in the synagogue and promises to return.

stops.label: Caesarea
stops.name: Caesarea
stops.text: And when he had landed at Caesarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.
stops.note: "When he had landed at Caesarea, and gone up, and saluted the church…"

stops.label: Antioch
stops.name: Antioch
stops.text: And when he had landed at Caesarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.
stops.note: "…he went down to Antioch."

journeys.title: Third missionary journey
journeys.summary: Three years centred on Ephesus, a return through Macedonia and Greece, and a farewell voyage to Jerusalem.

stops.label: Antioch
stops.name: Antioch
stops.text: And when he had landed at Caesarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.
stops.note: "After he had spent some time there, he departed" (18:23).

stops.label: Galatia
stops.name: Galatia
stops.text: And after he had spent some time there, he departed, and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples.
stops.note: "…and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order."

stops.label: Phrygia
stops.name: Phrygia
stops.text: And after he had spent some time there, he departed, and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples.

stops.label: Ephesus
stops.name: Ephesus
stops.text: And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples,
stops.note: "Having passed through the upper coasts." Two years in the school of Tyrannus; the uproar over Diana.

stops.label: Macedonia
stops.name: Macedonia
stops.text: And after the uproar was ceased, Paul called unto him the disciples, and embraced them, and departed for to go into Macedonia.

stops.label: Greece
stops.name: Greece
stops.text: And when he had gone over those parts, and had given them much exhortation, he came into Greece,
stops.note: Three months there (20:3).

stops.label: Macedonia
stops.name: Macedonia
stops.text: And there abode three months. And when the Jews laid wait for him, as he was about to sail into Syria, he purposed to return through Macedonia.
stops.note: A plot of the Jews makes him return through Macedonia.

stops.label: Philippi
stops.name: Philippi
stops.text: And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread, and came unto them to Troas in five days; where we abode seven days.
stops.note: "We sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread."

stops.label: Troas
stops.name: Troas
stops.text: And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread, and came unto them to Troas in five days; where we abode seven days.
stops.note: Eutychus falls from the third loft and is restored.

stops.label: Assos
stops.name: Assos
stops.text: And we went before to ship, and sailed unto Assos, there intending to take in Paul: for so had he appointed, minding himself to go afoot.
stops.note: Paul goes on foot; the others sail.

stops.label: Mitylene
stops.name: Mitylene
stops.text: And when he met with us at Assos, we took him in, and came to Mitylene.

stops.label: Chios
stops.name: Chios
stops.text: And we sailed thence, and came the next day over against Chios; and the next day we arrived at Samos, and tarried at Trogyllium; and the next day we came to Miletus.
stops.note: "Over against Chios."

stops.label: Samos
stops.name: Samos
stops.text: And we sailed thence, and came the next day over against Chios; and the next day we arrived at Samos, and tarried at Trogyllium; and the next day we came to Miletus.

stops.label: Trogyllium
stops.name: Trogyllium
stops.text: And we sailed thence, and came the next day over against Chios; and the next day we arrived at Samos, and tarried at Trogyllium; and the next day we came to Miletus.

stops.label: Miletus
stops.name: Miletus
stops.text: And we sailed thence, and came the next day over against Chios; and the next day we arrived at Samos, and tarried at Trogyllium; and the next day we came to Miletus.
stops.note: Farewell to the elders of Ephesus: "ye all… shall see my face no more" (20:25).

stops.label: Coos
stops.name: Cos
stops.text: And it came to pass, that after we were gotten from them, and had launched, we came with a straight course unto Coos, and the day following unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara:

stops.label: Rhodes
stops.name: Rhodes
stops.text: And it came to pass, that after we were gotten from them, and had launched, we came with a straight course unto Coos, and the day following unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara:

stops.label: Patara
stops.name: Patara
stops.text: And it came to pass, that after we were gotten from them, and had launched, we came with a straight course unto Coos, and the day following unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara:

stops.label: Tyre
stops.name: Tyre
stops.text: Now when we had discovered Cyprus, we left it on the left hand, and sailed into Syria, and landed at Tyre: for there the ship was to unlade her burden.
stops.note: "When we had discovered Cyprus, we left it on the left hand."

stops.label: Ptolemais
stops.name: Ptolemais
stops.text: And when we had finished our course from Tyre, we came to Ptolemais, and saluted the brethren, and abode with them one day.

stops.label: Caesarea
stops.name: Caesarea
stops.text: And the next day we that were of Paul's company departed, and came unto Caesarea: and we entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, which was one of the seven; and abode with him.
stops.note: In the house of Philip the evangelist; Agabus binds his own hands with Paul's girdle.

stops.label: Jerusalem
stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.text: And when we were come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.
stops.note: Seized in the temple (21:30); "I am ready… to die at Jerusalem" (21:13).

journeys.title: Voyage to Rome
journeys.summary: A prisoner who has appealed unto Caesar: Caesarea, a storm and shipwreck at Melita, and Rome.

stops.label: Jerusalem
stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.text: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.
stops.note: "As thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome."

stops.label: Antipatris
stops.name: Aphek
stops.text: Then the soldiers, as it was commanded them, took Paul, and brought him by night to Antipatris.
stops.note: Taken by night under guard.

stops.label: Caesarea
stops.name: Caesarea
stops.text: Who, when they came to Caesarea, and delivered the epistle to the governor, presented Paul also before him.
stops.note: Two years before Felix, then Festus and Agrippa: "I appeal unto Caesar" (25:11).

stops.label: Sidon
stops.name: Sidon
stops.text: And the next day we touched at Sidon. And Julius courteously entreated Paul, and gave him liberty to go unto his friends to refresh himself.
stops.note: Julius courteously lets Paul visit his friends.

stops.label: Myra
stops.name: Myra
stops.text: And when we had sailed over the sea of Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.
stops.note: "We sailed under Cyprus, because the winds were contrary" (27:4).

stops.label: Cnidus
stops.name: Cnidus
stops.text: And when we had sailed slowly many days, and scarce were come over against Cnidus, the wind not suffering us, we sailed under Crete, over against Salmone;
stops.note: "Scarce were come over against Cnidus."

stops.label: Salmone
stops.name: Salmone
stops.text: And when we had sailed slowly many days, and scarce were come over against Cnidus, the wind not suffering us, we sailed under Crete, over against Salmone;
stops.note: "We sailed under Crete, over against Salmone."

stops.label: Fair havens
stops.name: Fair Havens
stops.text: And, hardly passing it, came unto a place which is called The fair havens; nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea.
stops.note: "Nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea."

stops.label: Clauda
stops.name: Cauda
stops.text: And running under a certain island which is called Clauda, we had much work to come by the boat:
stops.note: Euroclydon; fourteen nights driven up and down in Adria (27:27).

stops.label: Melita
stops.name: Malta
stops.text: And when they were escaped, then they knew that the island was called Melita.
stops.note: Shipwrecked: "they escaped all safe to land" (27:44). The viper.

stops.label: Syracuse
stops.name: Syracuse
stops.text: And landing at Syracuse, we tarried there three days.

stops.label: Rhegium
stops.name: Rhegium
stops.text: And from thence we fetched a compass, and came to Rhegium: and after one day the south wind blew, and we came the next day to Puteoli:

stops.label: Puteoli
stops.name: Puteoli
stops.text: And from thence we fetched a compass, and came to Rhegium: and after one day the south wind blew, and we came the next day to Puteoli:
stops.note: Brethren there; seven days.

stops.label: Appii forum
stops.name: Forum of Appius
stops.text: And from thence, when the brethren heard of us, they came to meet us as far as Appii forum, and The three taverns: whom when Paul saw, he thanked God, and took courage.
stops.note: Brethren come out to meet them; "he thanked God, and took courage."

stops.label: The three taverns
stops.name: Three Taverns
stops.text: And from thence, when the brethren heard of us, they came to meet us as far as Appii forum, and The three taverns: whom when Paul saw, he thanked God, and took courage.

stops.label: Rome
stops.name: Rome
stops.text: And when we came to Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard: but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him.
stops.note: Two whole years in his own hired house, "preaching the kingdom of God" (28:30–31).

journeys.title: Birth and childhood
journeys.summary: From the annunciation at Nazareth to the boy in the temple. Order of events follows A. T. Robertson's Harmony of the Gospels.

stops.label: Nazareth
stops.name: Nazareth
stops.text: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
stops.note: The angel Gabriel is sent to Mary.

stops.label: Bethlehem
stops.name: Bethlehem
stops.text: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)
stops.note: The decree of Caesar Augustus; Jesus is born and laid in a manger.

stops.label: Jerusalem
stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.text: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;
stops.note: Presented to the Lord in the temple; Simeon and Anna.

stops.label: Bethlehem
stops.name: Bethlehem
stops.text: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,
stops.note: Wise men from the east; the star stands over "the house" (2:11).

stops.label: Egypt
stops.name: Egypt
stops.text: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:
stops.note: "Out of Egypt have I called my son" (2:15). Where in Egypt is not said.

stops.label: Nazareth
stops.name: Nazareth
stops.text: And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.
stops.note: "He shall be called a Nazarene."

stops.label: Jerusalem
stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.text: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.
stops.note: Twelve years old: "wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?" (2:49).

stops.label: Nazareth
stops.name: Nazareth
stops.text: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
stops.note: "Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man."

journeys.title: His ministry
journeys.summary: From his baptism to the anointing at Bethany. The Gospels often group events by theme rather than date, so this order follows A. T. Robertson's Harmony (1922).

stops.label: Nazareth
stops.name: Nazareth
stops.text: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.
stops.note: "Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee…"

stops.label: Jordan
stops.name: Jordan
stops.text: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.
stops.note: "…and was baptized of John in Jordan." Then forty days tempted in the wilderness (1:12–13).

stops.label: Bethabara
stops.name: Bethany
stops.text: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.
stops.note: "Behold the Lamb of God" (1:29). Andrew and Simon Peter follow him (1:40–42).

stops.label: Cana
stops.name: Cana
stops.text: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:
stops.note: Water made wine: "This beginning of miracles" (2:11).

stops.label: Capernaum
stops.name: Capernaum
stops.text: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.

stops.label: Jerusalem
stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.text: And the Jews' passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,
stops.note: Passover; he drives the changers of money out of the temple; Nicodemus by night (3:1–21).

stops.label: Sychar
stops.name: Sychar
stops.text: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
stops.note: "He must needs go through Samaria" (4:4). The woman at the well.

stops.label: Cana
stops.name: Cana
stops.text: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
stops.note: The nobleman's son healed at a word.

stops.label: Nazareth
stops.name: Nazareth
stops.text: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.
stops.note: "This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears." They try to cast him down the hill.

stops.label: Capernaum
stops.name: Capernaum
stops.text: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.
stops.note: He comes to dwell in Capernaum (Matthew 4:13).

stops.label: Gennesaret
stops.name: Gennesaret
stops.text: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,
stops.note: The great draught of fishes: "from henceforth thou shalt catch men" (5:10).

stops.label: Jerusalem
stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.text: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
stops.note: The impotent man healed at the pool of Bethesda on the sabbath.

stops.label: Capernaum
stops.name: Capernaum
stops.text: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
stops.note: After the sermon of Luke 6:20–49, spoken as he "stood in the plain" (6:17); the centurion's servant.

stops.label: Nain
stops.name: Nain
stops.text: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.
stops.note: The widow's son raised.

stops.label: Gergesenes
stops.name: Gadara
stops.text: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.
stops.note: The storm stilled; Legion. Matthew says Gergesenes, Mark and Luke Gadarenes; the exact spot on the eastern shore is not known.

stops.label: Bethsaida
stops.name: Bethsaida
stops.text: And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.
stops.note: Five thousand fed.

stops.label: Gennesaret
stops.name: Gennesaret
stops.text: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.
stops.note: After walking on the water.

stops.label: Capernaum
stops.name: Capernaum
stops.text: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
stops.note: "I am the bread of life" (6:35).

stops.label: Tyre
stops.name: Tyre
stops.text: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it: but he could not be hid.
stops.note: The Syrophenician woman's daughter.

stops.label: Sidon
stops.name: Sidon
stops.text: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.

stops.label: Decapolis
stops.name: Decapolis
stops.text: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.
stops.note: The deaf man: "Ephphatha."

stops.label: Dalmanutha
stops.name: Dalmanutha
stops.text: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
stops.note: After four thousand are fed (8:1–9).

stops.label: Bethsaida
stops.name: Bethsaida
stops.text: And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.
stops.note: A blind man healed in two stages.

stops.label: Caesarea Philippi
stops.name: Caesarea Philippi
stops.text: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Caesarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?
stops.note: "Thou art the Christ" (8:29). The transfiguration follows "after six days" (9:2).

stops.label: Capernaum
stops.name: Capernaum
stops.text: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?
stops.note: "Who should be the greatest?"

stops.label: Jerusalem
stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.text: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?
stops.note: The feast of tabernacles: "If any man thirst, let him come unto me" (7:37).

stops.label: Jerusalem
stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.text: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.
stops.note: The feast of the dedication: "I and my Father are one" (10:30).

stops.label: Jordan
stops.name: Jordan
stops.text: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.
stops.note: "Beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized."

stops.label: Bethany
stops.name: Bethany
stops.text: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:
stops.note: Lazarus raised: "I am the resurrection, and the life" (11:25).

stops.label: Ephraim
stops.name: Ephraim
stops.text: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.
stops.note: "Unto a country near to the wilderness."

stops.label: Jericho
stops.name: Jericho
stops.text: And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.
stops.note: Blind Bartimaeus (Mark 10:46); Zacchaeus.

stops.label: Bethany
stops.name: Bethany
stops.text: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
stops.note: Six days before the passover; Mary anoints his feet.

journeys.title: The last week and resurrection
journeys.summary: From the triumphal entry to the ascension. Most of these places are within two miles of each other — zoom in on Jerusalem.

stops.label: Bethany
stops.name: Bethany
stops.text: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

stops.label: Bethphage
stops.name: Bethphage
stops.text: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,
stops.note: Two disciples are sent for the ass and the colt.

stops.label: Jerusalem
stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.text: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?
stops.note: "Hosanna to the son of David." All the city is moved.

stops.label: Bethany
stops.name: Bethany
stops.text: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.
stops.note: He lodges at Bethany.

stops.label: Jerusalem
stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.text: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;
stops.note: He casts out them that sold and bought in the temple.

stops.label: mount of Olives
stops.name: Mount of Olives
stops.text: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,
stops.note: His words on the last days: "Take ye heed, watch and pray" (13:33).

stops.label: Bethany
stops.name: Bethany
stops.text: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.
stops.note: In the house of Simon the leper: the alabaster box of ointment.

stops.label: the city
stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.text: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.
stops.note: "When ye are entered into the city": the upper room and the last supper.

stops.label: mount of Olives
stops.name: Mount of Olives
stops.text: And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.

stops.label: Gethsemane
stops.name: Gethsemane
stops.text: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.
stops.note: "Not what I will, but what thou wilt." Betrayed and taken.

stops.label: Golgotha
stops.name: Golgotha
stops.text: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.
stops.note: Crucified; laid in a new sepulchre in a garden nearby (John 19:41). Risen the third day.

stops.label: Emmaus
stops.name: Emmaus
stops.text: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.
stops.note: "Did not our heart burn within us?" (24:32).

stops.label: Jerusalem
stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.text: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,
stops.note: He stands in the midst of them: "Peace be unto you."

stops.label: sea of Tiberias
stops.name: Sea of Galilee
stops.text: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.
stops.note: Breakfast on the shore; "Feed my sheep" (21:16).

stops.label: Galilee
stops.name: Galilee
stops.text: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.
stops.note: The eleven on the mountain: "Go ye therefore, and teach all nations."

stops.label: Bethany
stops.name: Bethany
stops.text: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
stops.note: Carried up into heaven from "the mount called Olivet" (Acts 1:12).

journeys.title: Abraham's travels
journeys.summary: From Ur of the Chaldees to the land God promised, where he lived as a stranger (Hebrews 11:8–10).

stops.label: Ur of the Chaldees
stops.name: Ur
stops.text: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son's son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram's wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.
stops.note: Terah takes Abram, Sarai and Lot "to go into the land of Canaan."

stops.label: Haran
stops.name: Haran
stops.text: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son's son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram's wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.
stops.note: They dwell there; Terah dies. Then: "Get thee out of thy country" (12:1).

stops.label: Sichem
stops.name: Shechem
stops.text: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite was then in the land.
stops.note: "Unto thy seed will I give this land" (12:7). His first altar in Canaan.

stops.label: Bethel
stops.name: Bethel
stops.text: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Bethel, and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the LORD, and called upon the name of the LORD.
stops.note: His tent between Bethel and Hai; another altar.

stops.label: Egypt
stops.name: Egypt
stops.text: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land.
stops.note: Famine in the land; Sarai taken into Pharaoh's house.

stops.label: Bethel
stops.name: Bethel
stops.text: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Bethel, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Hai;
stops.note: Back to the place of the altar; Abram and Lot separate.

stops.label: Mamre
stops.name: Mamre
stops.text: Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD.
stops.note: "The plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron."

stops.label: Dan
stops.name: Dan
stops.text: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained servants, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued them unto Dan.
stops.note: He pursues the kings to rescue Lot…

stops.label: Hobah
stops.name: Hobah
stops.text: And he divided himself against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
stops.note: "…which is on the left hand of Damascus."

stops.label: Salem
stops.name: Salem
stops.text: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was the priest of the most high God.
stops.note: Melchizedek king of Salem brings forth bread and wine.

stops.label: Mamre
stops.name: Mamre
stops.text: And the LORD appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;
stops.note: The LORD appears to him: "Is any thing too hard for the LORD?" (18:14).

stops.label: Gerar
stops.name: Gerar
stops.text: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.
stops.note: "Between Kadesh and Shur"; Abimelech king of Gerar.

stops.label: Beersheba
stops.name: Beersheba
stops.text: Wherefore he called that place Beersheba; because there they sware both of them.
stops.note: Isaac is born (21:2); the well of the oath.

stops.label: Moriah
stops.name: Moriah
stops.text: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.
stops.note: "God will provide himself a lamb" (22:8). 2 Chronicles 3:1 places mount Moriah at Jerusalem.

stops.label: Beersheba
stops.name: Beersheba
stops.text: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beersheba.

stops.label: Hebron
stops.name: Hebron
stops.text: And Sarah died in Kirjatharba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
stops.note: Sarah dies; Abraham buys the cave of Machpelah, where he too is buried (25:9).

journeys.title: Jacob's journeys
journeys.summary: Fleeing Esau to Haran, twenty years with Laban, and the return to Canaan as Israel.

stops.label: Beersheba
stops.name: Beersheba
stops.text: And Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.
stops.note: "Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran."

stops.label: Bethel
stops.name: Bethel
stops.text: And he called the name of that place Bethel: but the name of that city was called Luz at the first.
stops.note: The ladder: "Surely the LORD is in this place."

stops.label: Haran
stops.name: Haran
stops.text: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence be ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.
stops.note: "Of Haran are we." Twenty years serving Laban (31:41).

stops.label: Gilead
stops.name: Gilead
stops.text: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face toward the mount Gilead.
stops.note: He flees; Laban overtakes him in mount Gilead (31:23). The covenant heap.

stops.label: Mahanaim
stops.name: Mahanaim
stops.text: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is God's host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.
stops.note: "This is God's host."

stops.label: Peniel
stops.name: Penuel
stops.text: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.
stops.note: He wrestles until daybreak: "I have seen God face to face."

stops.label: Succoth
stops.name: Succoth
stops.text: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
stops.note: After meeting Esau.

stops.label: Shechem
stops.name: Shechem
stops.text: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padanaram; and pitched his tent before the city.

stops.label: Bethel
stops.name: Bethel
stops.text: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Bethel, he and all the people that were with him.
stops.note: "Thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel" (35:10).

stops.label: Bethlehem
stops.name: Bethlehem
stops.text: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Bethlehem.
stops.note: Rachel dies giving birth to Benjamin.

stops.label: Mamre
stops.name: Mamre
stops.text: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.
stops.note: He comes to Isaac his father at Hebron.

journeys.title: Joseph sold into Egypt
journeys.summary: Sent by his father to his brothers, sold to the Ishmeelites, and carried down to Egypt.

stops.label: Hebron
stops.name: Valley of Hebron
stops.text: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
stops.note: "He sent him out of the vale of Hebron…"

stops.label: Shechem
stops.name: Shechem
stops.text: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
stops.note: "…and he came to Shechem."

stops.label: Dothan
stops.name: Dothan
stops.text: And the man said, They are departed hence; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.
stops.note: Cast into a pit and sold for twenty pieces of silver (37:28).

stops.label: Egypt
stops.name: Egypt
stops.text: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.
stops.note: Sold to Potiphar, captain of the guard (37:36).

journeys.title: Israel goes down to Egypt
journeys.summary: Jacob's household moves to Goshen; at his death Joseph carries him back to be buried at Machpelah.

stops.label: Beersheba
stops.name: Beersheba
stops.text: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.
stops.note: "Fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation" (46:3).

stops.label: Goshen
stops.name: Goshen
stops.text: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.
stops.note: Seventy souls (46:27). Jacob meets Joseph again.

stops.label: Atad
stops.name: Atad
stops.text: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.
stops.note: "The threshingfloor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan": seven days of mourning.

stops.label: Mamre
stops.name: Mamre
stops.text: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.
stops.note: Buried in the cave of Machpelah.

journeys.title: The Exodus: Egypt to Sinai
journeys.summary: Out of Egypt, through the Red Sea, to the mount of God. Shown on the traditional route; the place of the crossing and the location of Sinai are both debated.

stops.label: Rameses
stops.name: Rameses
stops.text: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot that were men, beside children.
stops.note: "About six hundred thousand on foot that were men, beside children."

stops.label: Succoth
stops.name: Succoth
stops.text: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot that were men, beside children.

stops.label: Etham
stops.name: Etham
stops.located: One of the sites OpenBible.info proposes for Etham: Tell Abu Sefeh.
stops.text: And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.
stops.note: "In the edge of the wilderness." The pillar of a cloud by day and of fire by night (13:21).

stops.label: Pihahiroth
stops.name: Pi-hahiroth
stops.located: Placed by the traditional view — the head of the Gulf of Suez. The International Standard Bible Encyclopedia (M. G. Kyle) places Pi-hahiroth "along the old shore line of the Sea within 10 miles of the site of modern Suez", because the crossing must lie within three days' journey of Marah (Exodus 15:22–23).
stops.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baalzephon: before it shall ye encamp by the sea.
stops.note: "That they turn and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea." Pharaoh overtakes them encamping by the sea (14:9).

stops.label: wilderness of Shur
stops.name: Shur
stops.located: One of the sites OpenBible.info proposes for Shur: about 30 km around Wadi as Sakriyat.
stops.text: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
stops.note: "The children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left" (14:22). The song of Moses (15:1–18). The crossing is shown at the head of the Gulf of Suez, the traditional site; the Bitter Lakes, Lake Timsah and the Gulf of Aqaba have also been proposed.

stops.label: Marah
stops.name: Marah
stops.text: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.
stops.note: Bitter waters made sweet.

stops.label: Elim
stops.name: Elim
stops.text: And they came to Elim, where were twelve wells of water, and threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.
stops.note: Twelve wells of water and threescore and ten palm trees.

stops.label: Sin
stops.name: Sin
stops.text: And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.
stops.note: "Between Elim and Sinai": manna and quails.

stops.label: Dophkah
stops.name: Dophkah
stops.text: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

stops.label: Alush
stops.name: Alush
stops.text: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

stops.label: Rephidim
stops.name: Rephidim
stops.text: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of the LORD, and pitched in Rephidim: and there was no water for the people to drink.
stops.note: Water from the rock; Amalek overcome while Moses' hands are held up.

stops.label: mount Sinai
stops.name: Mount Sinai
stops.text: And the LORD came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the LORD called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.
stops.note: The ten commandments and the law; the tabernacle. Nearly a year there (Numbers 10:11).

journeys.title: The Exodus: Sinai to the Jordan
journeys.summary: Forty years in the wilderness and the way around Edom, to the plains of Moab and across the Jordan. Many campsites cannot be located with confidence.

stops.label: Sinai
stops.name: Wilderness of Sinai
stops.text: And the children of Israel took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.
stops.note: "The children of Israel took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai."

stops.label: Kibrothhattaavah
stops.name: Kibroth-hattaavah
stops.text: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibrothhattaavah.
stops.note: The quails: "there they buried the people that lusted" (11:34).

stops.label: Hazeroth
stops.name: Hazeroth
stops.text: And the people journeyed from Kibrothhattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.
stops.note: Miriam and Aaron speak against Moses (12:1).

stops.label: Kadesh
stops.name: Kadesh-barnea
stops.text: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.
stops.note: The twelve spies return; the people will not go in, and must wander forty years (14:33–34).

stops.label: mount Hor
stops.name: Mount Hor
stops.text: And the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came unto mount Hor.
stops.note: Edom refuses them passage (20:14–21); Aaron dies.

stops.label: Eziongaber
stops.name: Ezion-geber
stops.text: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from Eziongaber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
stops.note: "By the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom" (Numbers 21:4). The serpent of brass (Numbers 21:9).

stops.label: Punon
stops.name: Punon
stops.text: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.

stops.label: Oboth
stops.name: Oboth
stops.text: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in Oboth.

stops.label: Ijeabarim
stops.name: Iye-abarim
stops.text: And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Ijeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.

stops.label: Zared
stops.name: Valley of Zered
stops.text: From thence they removed, and pitched in the valley of Zared.

stops.label: Arnon
stops.name: Arnon
stops.text: From thence they removed, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, which is in the wilderness that cometh out of the coasts of the Amorites: for Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
stops.note: The border of Moab. Sihon and Og are defeated (21:21–35).

stops.label: Dibongad
stops.name: Dibon
stops.text: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibongad.

stops.label: Almondiblathaim
stops.name: Almon-diblathaim
stops.text: And they removed from Dibongad, and encamped in Almondiblathaim.

stops.label: plains of Moab
stops.name: Moab
stops.text: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan by Jericho.
stops.note: Balaam; Moses' farewell words (Deuteronomy).

stops.label: Nebo
stops.name: Mount Nebo
stops.text: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is over against Jericho. And the LORD shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,
stops.note: Moses sees the land and dies there; "no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day."

stops.label: Gilgal
stops.name: Gilgal
stops.text: And the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, in the east border of Jericho.
stops.note: The waters of Jordan stand upon an heap (3:16) and Israel passes over on dry ground.

journeys.title: Joshua's conquest of Canaan
journeys.summary: Jericho and Ai, the long day at Gibeon, the southern cities, and the northern kings at the waters of Merom.

stops.label: Shittim
stops.name: Shittim
stops.text: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot's house, named Rahab, and lodged there.
stops.note: Two spies are sent; Rahab hides them.

stops.label: Gilgal
stops.name: Gilgal
stops.text: And the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, in the east border of Jericho.
stops.note: Israel passes over Jordan; twelve stones set up.

stops.label: Jericho
stops.name: Jericho
stops.text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, See, I have given into thine hand Jericho, and the king thereof, and the mighty men of valour.
stops.note: Seven days around the city; the wall falls down flat (6:20).

stops.label: Ai
stops.name: Ai
stops.text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear not, neither be thou dismayed: take all the people of war with thee, and arise, go up to Ai: see, I have given into thy hand the king of Ai, and his people, and his city, and his land:
stops.note: After Achan's sin (chapter 7), Ai is taken by ambush.

stops.label: mount Ebal
stops.name: Mount Ebal
stops.text: Then Joshua built an altar unto the LORD God of Israel in mount Ebal,
stops.note: An altar; the law read before all the congregation.

stops.label: Gilgal
stops.name: Gilgal
stops.text: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal, and said unto him, and to the men of Israel, We be come from a far country: now therefore make ye a league with us.
stops.note: The Gibeonites deceive Israel into a league.

stops.label: Gibeon
stops.name: Gibeon
stops.text: And the LORD discomfited them before Israel, and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goeth up to Bethhoron, and smote them to Azekah, and unto Makkedah.
stops.note: "Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon" (10:12).

stops.label: Bethhoron
stops.name: Beth-horon
stops.text: And it came to pass, as they fled from before Israel, and were in the going down to Bethhoron, that the LORD cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah, and they died: they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword.
stops.note: Great stones from heaven on the fleeing armies.

stops.label: Makkedah
stops.name: Makkedah
stops.text: But these five kings fled, and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.
stops.note: The five kings hid in a cave.

stops.label: Libnah
stops.name: Libnah
stops.text: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, unto Libnah, and fought against Libnah:

stops.label: Lachish
stops.name: Lachish
stops.text: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, unto Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it:

stops.label: Eglon
stops.name: Eglon
stops.text: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon, and all Israel with him; and they encamped against it, and fought against it:

stops.label: Hebron
stops.name: Hebron
stops.text: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it:

stops.label: Debir
stops.name: Debir
stops.text: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and fought against it:

stops.label: Gilgal
stops.name: Gilgal
stops.text: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.
stops.note: "Because the LORD God of Israel fought for Israel" (10:42).

stops.label: waters of Merom
stops.name: Waters of Merom
stops.text: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly; and they fell upon them.
stops.note: The northern kings gathered at the waters of Merom.

stops.label: Hazor
stops.name: Hazor
stops.text: And Joshua at that time turned back, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.
stops.note: "Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms."

journeys.title: Ruth and Naomi
journeys.summary: Naomi's family goes to Moab in a famine; she returns a widow, with Ruth her daughter in law: "whither thou goest, I will go" (1:16).

stops.label: Bethlehemjudah
stops.name: Bethlehem
stops.text: Now it came to pass in the days when the judges ruled, that there was a famine in the land. And a certain man of Bethlehemjudah went to sojourn in the country of Moab, he, and his wife, and his two sons.
stops.note: "There was a famine in the land."

stops.label: Moab
stops.name: Moab
stops.text: Now it came to pass in the days when the judges ruled, that there was a famine in the land. And a certain man of Bethlehemjudah went to sojourn in the country of Moab, he, and his wife, and his two sons.
stops.note: Elimelech and his sons die there.

stops.label: Bethlehem
stops.name: Bethlehem
stops.text: So they two went until they came to Bethlehem. And it came to pass, when they were come to Bethlehem, that all the city was moved about them, and they said, Is this Naomi?
stops.note: At the beginning of barley harvest. Ruth gleans in Boaz's field; their son Obed is David's grandfather (4:17).

journeys.title: The ark of the covenant
journeys.summary: Taken to battle from Shiloh, captured by the Philistines, sent back on a new cart, and at last brought up by David to Jerusalem.

stops.label: Shiloh
stops.name: Shiloh
stops.text: So the people sent to Shiloh, that they might bring from thence the ark of the covenant of the LORD of hosts, which dwelleth between the cherubims: and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.
stops.note: "The people sent to Shiloh, that they might bring from thence the ark."

stops.label: Ebenezer
stops.name: Ebenezer
stops.text: And the Philistines took the ark of God, and brought it from Ebenezer unto Ashdod.
stops.note: Israel is smitten and the ark is taken (4:10–11).

stops.label: Ashdod
stops.name: Ashdod
stops.text: And the Philistines took the ark of God, and brought it from Ebenezer unto Ashdod.
stops.note: Dagon fallen on his face before the ark.

stops.label: Gath
stops.name: Gath
stops.text: They sent therefore and gathered all the lords of the Philistines unto them, and said, What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel? And they answered, Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried about unto Gath. And they carried the ark of the God of Israel about thither.

stops.label: Ekron
stops.name: Ekron
stops.text: Therefore they sent the ark of God to Ekron. And it came to pass, as the ark of God came to Ekron, that the Ekronites cried out, saying, They have brought about the ark of the God of Israel to us, to slay us and our people.

stops.label: Bethshemesh
stops.name: Beth-shemesh
stops.text: And the kine took the straight way to the way of Bethshemesh, and went along the highway, lowing as they went, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left; and the lords of the Philistines went after them unto the border of Bethshemesh.
stops.note: The kine take the straight way, lowing as they go.

stops.label: Kirjathjearim
stops.name: Kiriath-jearim
stops.text: And the men of Kirjathjearim came, and fetched up the ark of the LORD, and brought it into the house of Abinadab in the hill, and sanctified Eleazar his son to keep the ark of the LORD.
stops.note: In the house of Abinadab twenty years (7:2).

stops.label: Jerusalem
stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.text: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land: which spake unto David, saying, Except thou take away the blind and the lame, thou shalt not come in hither: thinking, David cannot come in hither.
stops.note: David takes the strong hold of Zion and dwells there (5:7). The ark is brought up with shouting, after Uzzah's death and three months at the house of Obededom (6:1–15).

journeys.title: David fleeing from Saul
journeys.summary: From Ramah to Ziklag: years as a fugitive, twice sparing Saul's life, until he is anointed king over Judah at Hebron.

stops.label: Ramah
stops.name: Ramah
stops.text: So David fled, and escaped, and came to Samuel to Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and dwelt in Naioth.
stops.note: He escapes to Samuel, and they dwell in Naioth.

stops.label: Nob
stops.name: Nob
stops.text: Then came David to Nob to Ahimelech the priest: and Ahimelech was afraid at the meeting of David, and said unto him, Why art thou alone, and no man with thee?
stops.note: Ahimelech gives him the shewbread and Goliath's sword.

stops.label: Gath
stops.name: Gath
stops.text: And David arose, and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.
stops.note: He feigns madness before Achish.

stops.label: Adullam
stops.name: Adullam
stops.text: David therefore departed thence, and escaped to the cave Adullam: and when his brethren and all his father's house heard it, they went down thither to him.
stops.note: The cave; about four hundred men gather to him.

stops.label: Mizpeh of Moab
stops.name: Mizpeh
stops.text: And David went thence to Mizpeh of Moab: and he said unto the king of Moab, Let my father and my mother, I pray thee, come forth, and be with you, till I know what God will do for me.
stops.note: He leaves his father and mother with the king of Moab.

stops.label: Hareth
stops.name: Hereth
stops.text: And the prophet Gad said unto David, Abide not in the hold; depart, and get thee into the land of Judah. Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hareth.
stops.note: "Abide not in the hold; depart, and get thee into the land of Judah."

stops.label: Keilah
stops.name: Keilah
stops.text: So David and his men went to Keilah, and fought with the Philistines, and brought away their cattle, and smote them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.
stops.note: He saves Keilah from the Philistines.

stops.label: Ziph
stops.name: Ziph
stops.text: And David abode in the wilderness in strong holds, and remained in a mountain in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul sought him every day, but God delivered him not into his hand.
stops.note: Jonathan strengthens his hand in God (23:16).

stops.label: wilderness of Maon
stops.name: Wilderness of Maon
stops.text: And they arose, and went to Ziph before Saul: but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the plain on the south of Jeshimon.

stops.label: Engedi
stops.name: Engedi
stops.text: And David went up from thence, and dwelt in strong holds at Engedi.
stops.note: He cuts off the skirt of Saul's robe in the cave (24:4).

stops.label: Carmel
stops.name: Carmel
stops.text: And there was a man in Maon, whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great, and he had three thousand sheep, and a thousand goats: and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.
stops.note: Nabal and Abigail.

stops.label: Hachilah
stops.name: Hachilah
stops.text: And the Ziphites came unto Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon?
stops.note: He takes Saul's spear and cruse of water as he sleeps.

stops.label: Gath
stops.name: Gath
stops.text: And David arose, and he passed over with the six hundred men that were with him unto Achish, the son of Maoch, king of Gath.
stops.note: With six hundred men, to Achish.

stops.label: Ziklag
stops.name: Ziklag
stops.text: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: wherefore Ziklag pertaineth unto the kings of Judah unto this day.
stops.note: Given him by Achish; "a full year and four months" among the Philistines (27:7).

stops.label: Ziklag
stops.name: Ziklag
stops.text: And it came to pass, when David and his men were come to Ziklag on the third day, that the Amalekites had invaded the south, and Ziklag, and smitten Ziklag, and burned it with fire;
stops.note: Burned by the Amalekites; "David encouraged himself in the LORD his God" (30:6).

stops.label: Hebron
stops.name: Hebron
stops.text: And it came to pass after this, that David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah? And the LORD said unto him, Go up. And David said, Whither shall I go up? And he said, Unto Hebron.
stops.note: Anointed king over the house of Judah (2:4).

journeys.title: Elijah
journeys.summary: The prophet of fire: the drought, mount Carmel, the still small voice at Horeb, and the chariot of fire.

stops.label: Gilead
stops.name: Gilead
stops.text: And Elijah the Tishbite, who was of the inhabitants of Gilead, said unto Ahab, As the LORD God of Israel liveth, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.
stops.note: "There shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word."

stops.label: Cherith
stops.name: Cherith
stops.text: Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
stops.note: "The brook Cherith, that is before Jordan": fed by ravens.

stops.label: Zarephath
stops.name: Zarephath
stops.text: Arise, get thee to Zarephath, which belongeth to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee.
stops.note: The widow's barrel of meal and cruse of oil; her son raised.

stops.label: mount Carmel
stops.name: Mount Carmel
stops.text: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.
stops.note: "The LORD, he is the God" (18:39).

stops.label: Jezreel
stops.name: Jezreel
stops.text: And the hand of the LORD was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
stops.note: He runs before Ahab's chariot.

stops.label: Beersheba
stops.name: Beersheba
stops.text: And when he saw that, he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongeth to Judah, and left his servant there.
stops.note: He flees from Jezebel.

stops.label: Horeb
stops.name: Mount Horeb
stops.text: And he arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God.
stops.note: Forty days and nights; "a still small voice" (19:12).

stops.label: Abelmeholah
stops.name: Abel-meholah
stops.text: And Jehu the son of Nimshi shalt thou anoint to be king over Israel: and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abelmeholah shalt thou anoint to be prophet in thy room.
stops.note: Elisha's home; Elijah finds him ploughing and casts his mantle upon him (19:19).

stops.label: Jezreel
stops.name: Jezreel
stops.text: And it came to pass after these things, that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
stops.note: Naboth's vineyard: "Hast thou found me, O mine enemy?" (21:20).

stops.label: Gilgal
stops.name: Gilgal
stops.text: And it came to pass, when the LORD would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.

stops.label: Bethel
stops.name: Bethel
stops.text: And Elijah said unto Elisha, Tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Bethel. And Elisha said unto him, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they went down to Bethel.

stops.label: Jericho
stops.name: Jericho
stops.text: And Elijah said unto him, Elisha, tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Jericho. And he said, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they came to Jericho.

stops.label: Jordan
stops.name: Jordan
stops.text: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood to view afar off: and they two stood by Jordan.
stops.note: He smites the waters and they go over on dry ground; "Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven" (2:11).

journeys.title: Jonah
journeys.summary: Sent to Nineveh, he flees the other way by sea; after the great fish he goes, and the city repents.

stops.label: Gathhepher
stops.name: Gath-hepher
stops.text: He restored the coast of Israel from the entering of Hamath unto the sea of the plain, according to the word of the LORD God of Israel, which he spake by the hand of his servant Jonah, the son of Amittai, the prophet, which was of Gathhepher.
stops.note: Jonah's home town.

stops.label: Joppa
stops.name: Joppa
stops.text: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD, and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD.
stops.note: "Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD." The storm and the great fish follow; where he was cast up is not said.

stops.label: Nineveh
stops.name: Nineveh
stops.text: So Jonah arose, and went unto Nineveh, according to the word of the LORD. Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days' journey.
stops.note: "An exceeding great city of three days' journey." The people repent in sackcloth.

journeys.title: Philip the evangelist
journeys.summary: Scattered by persecution, Philip preaches in Samaria, baptizes the Ethiopian eunuch on the Gaza road, and preaches up the coast to Caesarea.

stops.label: Jerusalem
stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.text: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria, except the apostles.
stops.note: A great persecution; "they were all scattered abroad… except the apostles."

stops.label: Samaria
stops.name: Samaria
stops.text: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them.
stops.note: Unclean spirits cast out; "there was great joy in that city" (8:8).

stops.label: Gaza
stops.name: Gaza
stops.text: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.
stops.note: "The way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert." The eunuch reading Isaiah.

stops.label: Azotus
stops.name: Ashdod
stops.text: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Caesarea.
stops.note: "Philip was found at Azotus…"

stops.label: Caesarea
stops.name: Caesarea
stops.text: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Caesarea.
stops.note: "…till he came to Caesarea."

journeys.title: Peter: Samaria, Lydda, Joppa and Caesarea
journeys.summary: From Samaria to the house of Cornelius, where the gospel opens to the Gentiles.

stops.label: Jerusalem
stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.text: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:
stops.note: The apostles send Peter and John to Samaria.

stops.label: Samaria
stops.name: Samaria
stops.text: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:
stops.note: They lay their hands on them; Simon the sorcerer.

stops.label: Jerusalem
stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.text: And they, when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.

stops.label: Lydda
stops.name: Lod
stops.text: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.
stops.note: Aeneas healed of the palsy.

stops.label: Joppa
stops.name: Joppa
stops.text: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.
stops.note: Tabitha (Dorcas) raised; the vision of the sheet let down from heaven (10:9–16).

stops.label: Caesarea
stops.name: Caesarea
stops.text: And the morrow after they entered into Caesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.
stops.note: "God is no respecter of persons" (10:34). The Holy Ghost falls on the Gentiles.

stops.label: Jerusalem
stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.text: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,
stops.note: "Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life" (11:18).

journeys.title: Israel carried away to Assyria
journeys.summary: Samaria falls after a three-year siege, and the northern kingdom is carried away "because they obeyed not the voice of the LORD" (18:12).

stops.label: Samaria
stops.name: Samaria
stops.text: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.
stops.note: Shalmaneser besieges Samaria three years.

stops.label: Assyria
stops.name: Assyria
stops.text: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
stops.note: "The king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria."

stops.label: Halah
stops.name: Halah
stops.text: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.

stops.label: Gozan
stops.name: Gozan
stops.text: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
stops.note: "In Habor by the river of Gozan."

stops.label: Medes
stops.name: Media
stops.text: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
stops.note: "And in the cities of the Medes."

journeys.title: Judah carried away to Babylon
journeys.summary: Jerusalem besieged by Nebuchadnezzar, the temple burned, and the people carried to Babylon, as Jeremiah had warned.

stops.label: Jerusalem
stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.text: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he, and all his host, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it; and they built forts against it round about.
stops.note: Nebuchadnezzar besieges the city; the wall is broken up (25:4).

stops.label: Riblah
stops.name: Riblah
stops.text: So they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.
stops.note: Zedekiah is judged; his sons slain before his eyes.

stops.label: Babylon
stops.name: Babylon
stops.text: And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Babylon.
stops.note: Zedekiah carried to Babylon in fetters; the temple burned (25:9). The route is not described.

journeys.title: The return from exile
journeys.summary: Cyrus lets the captives go home to build the house of the LORD; Ezra and later Nehemiah follow.

stops.label: Babylon
stops.name: Babylon
stops.text: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand and four hundred. All these did Sheshbazzar bring up with them of the captivity that were brought up from Babylon unto Jerusalem.
stops.note: Cyrus's decree (1:2–4): the vessels of the house of the LORD are sent back.

stops.label: Jerusalem
stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.text: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand and four hundred. All these did Sheshbazzar bring up with them of the captivity that were brought up from Babylon unto Jerusalem.
stops.note: "Them of the captivity that were brought up from Babylon unto Jerusalem." The temple is finished (6:15).

stops.label: Babylon
stops.name: Babylon
stops.text: For upon the first day of the first month began he to go up from Babylon, and on the first day of the fifth month came he to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God upon him.
stops.note: Ezra, "a ready scribe in the law of Moses" (7:6), sets out.

stops.label: Ahava
stops.name: Ahava
stops.text: And I gathered them together to the river that runneth to Ahava; and there abode we in tents three days: and I viewed the people, and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.
stops.note: They fast by the river Ahava for a right way.

stops.label: Jerusalem
stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.text: And we came to Jerusalem, and abode there three days.
stops.note: Four months after setting out (7:9).

stops.label: Shushan
stops.name: Susa
stops.text: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah. And it came to pass in the month Chisleu, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the palace,
stops.note: Nehemiah, the king's cupbearer, hears that the wall of Jerusalem is broken down.

stops.label: Jerusalem
stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.text: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.
stops.note: He views the walls by night; the wall is finished in fifty and two days (6:15).
